positions.commentary: Amazon is part of a corona-proof three-stock portfolio that has no impact from a pandemic.
Costco is booming and is part of a three-stock portfolio that is in great shape.
Berkshire is sitting on a big cash file and is in great shape.

thesis: This episode argues that a specific three-stock portfolio (AMZN, COST, BKRB) is 'corona-proof' and has 'no impact from a pandemic.' It further posits that these companies are in 'great shape,' with AMZN being part of a 'trillion dollar market cap' technology sector.

claims.quote: I mean, nothing's happened to Amazon. Costco is booming, and Berkshire is sitting on a big cash file, and they are in great shape.
